name: nax-toolkit
description: A toolkit of operational skills for nax projects. Currently bundles nax-setup (wire .nax/config.json to a repo's real build/test/lint commands, single-package or monorepo).

interface.shortDescription: Operational skills for nax projects (setup, config wiring)
interface.longDescription: Use nax-toolkit to set up and operate nax in any repo. The nax-setup skill wires .nax/config.json (quality, review, context, precheck, execution) to a repo's real build/test/lint commands — single-package or workspace monorepo — handling package-manager, orchestrator, and test-framework differences.
defaultPrompt: Set up nax for this repo.
